topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture aims, learning outcomes, and foundational framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell-surface receptors and intracellular signaling pathways drive proliferation and survival independently of external growth cues.

topics.label: Block to terminal cell differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells stall normal developmental maturation to sustain a proliferative progenitor state across different tissue types.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how tumor cells avoid programmed cell death by altering the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality and cellular senescence bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere maintenance and the circumvention of p53-mediated stress responses enable indefinite cell division, concluding the survey of growth control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the shift toward aerobic glycolysis in cancer cells and how metabolic enzyme mutations generate oncometabolites that promote tumor progression.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the angiogenic switch and blood vessel recruitment required to supply growing tumors with oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Mechanisms, tracking, and genomics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the multi-step cascade of metastatic dissemination, its clinical monitoring, microenvironmental barriers, and associated genomic features.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic reviews the core themes of the lecture and provides concluding remarks.
